responsibility: Provides the AVX10.2 BF16 intrinsic interface for 128-bit and 256-bit bfloat16 vector operations. It conditionally enables `avx10.2` and defines the `_mm*` and `_mm256*` BF16 arithmetic, comparison, classification, mantissa, scaling, reduction, and scalar-compare APIs on `__m128bh` and `__m256bh`, acting as the narrower-width companion to the 512-bit AVX10.2 BF16 header.
